## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2c38817d0aa0a8532fa2ba3d66e643e56fff0714`
Local-runs: none

Read: card objectui#12141 (body and all four comments: triage `6109764647`, deferral `6110270326`, claim `6115250926`, dev report `6115575587`), PR #12168 (body, 74-file list, net diff against `main` at the head), the head's check-runs (two readings in this act), and the two objectstack records the card cites (`6073921182`, `6112246741`). objectui `AGENTS.md` and `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` were read at the head for the rules applied below. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

The diff: 74 files, +634 / -181. Eleven non-test readers (ten under `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`, plus `studio-design/BuilderLanding.tsx`), 59 test files renamed one to one, two new test files, one docs line, one changeset. Each change the diff implies, judged:

1. **The wire accept-set moves whole, no dual read — right.** The client reads `entries[].allowEnvironmentOverlay` and nothing reads `allowOrgOverride`. Counted on the diff text: 164 removed lines name the old key, 184 added lines name the new one; the five added lines that still spell the old key are all in the changeset's FROM/TO and history prose. No `??` or `||` fallback to the old name anywhere. That is ruling Q2 A (`6073921182`: no dual-spelling window) and the card's own prohibition, kept.
2. **The published surface change is exactly the one declared — right.** `RichMetadataTypeEntry` (exported, `index.ts:466` at the head) loses `allowOrgOverride` and gains `allowEnvironmentOverlay`, same optional boolean; `resolveResourceConfig` (exported, `index.ts:436`) renames the same member on its server-entry parameter and its return type. Nothing else exported moves. This is the Clause-② change, judged in ②.
3. **Every write gate reads the new field, logic otherwise unchanged — right.** `ResourceEditPage`: `canWriteByType` (createMode, artifact and org-authored arms) and the designer auto-on `cw`; `PermissionMatrixEditor`: `canWriteByType` and `lockedByArtifactTier`; `ResourceListPage`: `typeWritable`; `EmbeddedItemEditor`: `readOnly`; `DirectoryPage`: `writableCount`, the "Writable only" filter and the tile badge; `PageShell`: `WritabilityBadge`. Each is a one-name substitution; the artifact arm still reads the flag alone (③ item 1). `Type Check` is `success` on this head, which is the compile proof that no typed reader of the old name remains.
4. **The banner remedy — right, and the done-when's third line is met.** `engine.edit.readOnlyTypeBanner` (en and zh) drops the `{override}` placeholder and the registry flip; the split regex in `ResourceEditPage` drops `{override}` to match; `{flag}` renders `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE`. Placeholders stay equal across en and zh (`{flag}`, `{type}`). The hatch tooltips on `DirectoryPage`'s tile and `PageShell`'s badge name `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` with its ADR-0131 D6 reach. The legacy `OBJECTSTACK_` spelling appears in added lines only inside `not.toContain` assertions and the changeset's history sentence.
5. **The `perm.readOnly*` hints — right as a bounded in-place fix.** `perm.readOnly.hint` keeps the hatch as a remedy and states its reach; `perm.readOnly.artifact.hint` withdraws the hatch as a route for a set a package ships. Both follow the card's own premise (a hatch-elevated type's managed items stay sealed, ADR-0131 D6) on lines the rename had already rewritten; `PermissionMatrixEditor.artifactTier` and `.cloneToCustomize` now pin the new sentence and the old route's absence. Scope reading in ③ deviation 2.
6. **The new pins carry the done-when's test with its negative control — right.** `ResourceEditPage.environmentOverlay-12141`: each of `view`, `dashboard`, `report`, `translation`, `email_template` opens a packaged item when served the field and stays locked without it (so `allowRuntimeCreate: true` alone opens no packaged item and no other name is read); `api` stays read-only, its banner names `OS_METADATA_WRITABLE` with no registry flip, en and zh. `DirectoryPage.environmentOverlay-12141`: the five tiles and the header badge; a hatch-elevated `agent` (overlay flag its only open door) badged writable and counted, "Writable only (6)" of seven; `api` and the field-less `agent` read-only and uncounted.
7. **Cross-lane boundary on `PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx` held — right.** Its hunks are the overlay-flag reads and the comments beside them; the epic #7611 C9 `sys_capability` read is untouched, as the claim's declaration promised.
8. **History comments took the new name — accepted on the card's terms, noted.** Headers and comments narrating objectui#4446, objectstack#6483 and `ee58392e1` now say `allowEnvironmentOverlay` where the name of their time was `allowOrgOverride`. The card's done-when requires `git grep allowOrgOverride` over `packages/**/src` to answer 0, which forces this; the changeset's FROM/TO line is where the old name lives. (S2's seat review `6112246741` asked the opposite of one objectstack history comment, under a different done-when; not re-adjudicated here.)
9. **One docs line renames the key but keeps "org overlay" beside it — wording drift, not the done-when's.** `content/docs/guide/console.md` now reads "an org overlay ... (`allowEnvironmentOverlay`)". Same class as the dev's third out-of-scope finding; ③ carries it.
10. **Governance and size — right.** No governed path in the file list (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` success); 815 changed lines; head repository equals base repository, so not a fork PR. The pending `.changeset/11808-readonly-package-card.md` keeps the old key as history, per the card; `Changeset Claim Re-read` success.

**Check-runs on the head, as read in this act (second reading, later than the first):** 42 runs. 30 `success` (among them `Lint`, `Type Check`, `Build & E2E`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Line Citation Gate`); 3 `skipped` (the coverage matrix placeholder, `Test (coverage)`, `dependabot`); 8 `in_progress` (`Test (shard 1/8)` through `(shard 8/8)`), which are not passes at this reading; 1 `failure`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`. That gate's own annotations attribute the red to `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/flow-node-refs.ts:145`, TS2367 (`"value"` versus `"flow-template"`), compiled against objectstack-ai/objectstack@`9963322fe8b6`. That file is not among this PR's 74 files; the workflow's header states its subject is the drift between the two repositories' `main` branches, moving when no file here changes, and that the context is requirable but not required. So the red is objectstack `main`'s shape moving under objectui `main`, not this diff's, and it will stand on every objectui PR until a sibling card moves `flow-node-refs.ts`. The job log itself was not readable through this act's channel (the log redirect answered Forbidden); the annotations are the reading.

### ② Semver level

- **Changeset** `.changeset/12141-allow-environment-overlay.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell: minor`. The body states BREAKING, the FROM `allowOrgOverride` TO `allowEnvironmentOverlay` mapping, the one-line migration (rename the member; its value is unchanged), the server precondition (a server carrying objectstack#22340 S2) and the failure mode against an older server. **Right.** objectui `AGENTS.md` at the head, line 272: 「objectui 自身的破坏性变更也标 `minor`(在正文里写清 breaking 语义即可)」, enforced by `scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`; `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Declaration` and `Changeset Fixed Group Check` are `success` on this head. No other released package changes; docs and tests are not published surface; `skip-changeset` does not apply.
- **`Clause-②: yes`** (PR body, and the changeset body's closing paragraph): **right.** A member of an exported type and of an exported function's parameter and return moves, so the published surface changes and this review is owed; the line corrects triage's `no` (`6109764647`), as the deferral note and the claim already did. One precision note: the closed-pair arm is omitted. A removed member is the `(narrowing)` arm under the declaration grammar, and S2 declared `yes (narrowing)` for the same rename on the objectstack side. The changeset body already carries the BREAKING statement and the migration that arm exists to force, and objectui's declaration gate passed, so the level and the consumer-facing text are complete; the line is one arm short. A body-only edit the adopting seat may make at adoption; it moves no level.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report `6115575587`: `open_questions` is empty. Six `deviations` and four `out_of_scope_findings`, each answered or escalated:

**Deviations**
1. *Two new test files outside the claim's enumerated list.* Answered: the card's done-when requires exactly this test (each write gate keyed on the new field, with a negative-control type); the files sit in the claim's directory, carry the card number, and no other claim can hold them. Accepted; the surface's intent is kept.
2. *Bounded in-place fix of the `perm.readOnly*` hints beyond the pure rename.* Answered: the lines were already rewritten by the rename; the old route (ask an operator for the hatch to open a packaged set) contradicts the card's own premise and the rule against advertising a capability the runtime does not deliver; both files are in the claim's surface; the two pins moved with it; the artifact-tier gate logic is untouched. Accepted as bounded; stated in the PR body and the report, as required.
3. *Reach wording on the banner and tooltips beyond the done-when minimum.* Answered: it states what the card itself says the hatch opens; en and zh move together. Accepted.
4. *Model-free commit trailers instead of the harness trailer.* Answered: that is the attribution rule; not a property of the diff. Noted.
5. *A probe test created and deleted, never committed.* Answered: the file list carries no such file. Accepted.
6. *Worktree and private refs removed; a remote-tracking ref left in the objectstack checkout.* Housekeeping, read-only. Accepted.

**Out-of-scope findings**
1. *The hatch value is wider than what it opens:* the artifact tier reads the flag alone, so a hatch-elevated type's packaged item offers Edit and the server refuses the save with 403. **Escalated to the adopting seat, to file as its own card.** The card leaves "whether this gate should read more than the flag" to this lane; the defect is pre-existing and loud, outside this done-when, so it does not hold this PR. It is reproducible (the dev's probe render) and the finding is already written in filing shape with dedupe words, so it belongs in a card, not only in acceptance notes. The card should name both halves of the seam: the client could read `overrideSource` beside the flag, or the wire could stop reporting `true` for a type whose managed items the hatch never opens; which half moves is the cross-layer question.
2. *Stale cross-file line addresses in `PermissionMatrixEditor`'s type-gate comment.* Answered: pre-existing; the cross-lane declaration limits this diff to the flag reads; `Line Citation Gate` reports 0 new citations. Carrier named (epic #7611 C9). Accepted.
3. *"org overlay" wording in the landing copy and comments after ADR-0131 D6 retired the per-org axis.* Answered: wording, not this card's. **Escalated as a wording follow-up card for the objectui lane**, because this diff's own `console.md` line (① item 9) is one instance it touched and left. Not blocking; objectstack's S3 covers only its own governed text.
4. *`cloneToCustomize`'s refused-save fixture quotes a pre-D6 server sentence, key renamed inside it.* Answered: the assertion is that the client shows the server's words verbatim, so the fixture's fidelity to current server prose is not what it pins; the rename inside it is forced by the done-when grep. Accepted as fixture drift; noted.

The window in which objectui `main` reads a field the server does not yet write is the ruled Q2 A shape; the bundled console keeps its pin until S2. Right.
